question: What alternatives to Giscus are supported?
expected: Supported alternatives, accurate settings, Cusdis archived/original hosting unavailable; no unsolicited setup recipe.

result.answer:
The following comment providers are supported as alternatives to Giscus:

*   **Disqus**: Requires `comments.disqus_shortname` (the registered site identifier). [Disqus comments](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/38-disqus-comments)
*   **Cactus**: Uses `comments.cactus_shortname` (the registered site name). It is hosted on Matrix only. [Cactus comments](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/39-cactus-comments)
*   **Welcomments**: Requires `comments.website_id`. [Welcomments comments](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/40-welcomments-comments)
*   **Cusdis**: Requires `comments.cusdis_app_id` and `comments.cusdis_host`. Note that the original hosting is unavailable as the upstream is archived. [Cusdis comments](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/41-cusdis-comments)

When switching, note that providers do not migrate threads automatically. To enable a provider, select it in `_config.yml` and ensure `show_comments: true` is set in the post/page front matter.

```yaml
comments:
  provider: disqus
  disqus_shortname: your-site-id
```

**Next step**: After editing `_config.yml`, commit your changes, wait for GitHub Actions to finish, and verify the comment interface on your published article.
